dedupe_keys.name: ipums nhgis us census and survey summary tables time series and gis boundary files from 1790 to the present

description: The IPUMS National Historical Geographic Information System (NHGIS) gives free online access to summary tables and time series of population, housing, agriculture and economic data, and GIS-compatible boundary files, for US censuses and other nationwide surveys from 1790 to the present, at all levels of census geography from states and counties to tracts and blocks. Through the Data Finder users filter thousands of tables and GIS files and download several tables and boundary files, for different geographic levels and years, in one request. Coverage: the United States, 1790 to present. Recent releases listed on the home page include 1980 and 1970 block boundaries for more metropolitan areas, watershed population and housing estimates with boundaries and crosswalks, the 2024 ACS 5-year summary file with time series extensions, and crosswalks for non-census years and for places, county subdivisions, ZCTAs, CBSAs, urban areas and PUMAs. Format and access: data files for spreadsheets, statistical software and GIS; NHGIS provides no analysis or mapping tools; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): IPUMS NHGIS terms of use: free with registration and citation; redistribution needs permission. Caveats: historical geographies change over time, which is why NHGIS publishes crosswalks; whether an account is needed to download was not checked. Simulation uses: long-run population and housing exposure by small area for hazard exposure, social vulnerability and capacity planning studies. Related records: the US Census Bureau TIGER/Line boundaries (data-us-census-tiger-line-boundaries-blocks) are the current official geometries.
